title: Room for rent
text:
ROOM FOR RENT

A big, sunny room in a flat in the city centre. The flat has got three bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.

Two students live there now: Ewa (20) and Marta (22). They are friendly and quiet.

The room has got a bed, a desk and a wardrobe. There is fast internet. The bus stop is two minutes from the flat.

Rent: 1,200 zł a month. No pets, please.

Call Ewa after 5 p.m. on 501 234 567.
